'''Derel Volk''' was an employee of the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]], and their usual representative to the annual [[Vor-cal Feast]] held at the [[House Melantha Orbital Hunting Lodge]] over [[Vycinyth]] due to his prowess as a [[Big game hunter/Legends|hunter]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]],Volk was set to attend the Feast, but [[Annora Calandra]] arranged for him to be elsewhere so that she could attend the event in his stead.<ref name="LE" />
